_comment: Head mask for pirate.mp4, normalised 0..1, authored at 720x1248. Positives cover face, hair and the WHOLE beard -- any template facial hair left outside the mask is a boundary Wan has to blend into, and it grows a matching beard on the reference to do it. Negatives hold the hat, coat and sky out. The graph unions this with a per-frame pose head mask, so a jumpy SAM frame cannot expose the original head.
